context_tags.personal-admin: Identity, residency, registrations, memberships, and personal administration.

document_type_tags.invoice: An itemized bill or request for payment; does not establish payment status.
document_type_tags.receipt: A document acknowledging a payment or purchase.
document_type_tags.statement: A periodic account summary, such as a bank or card statement.
document_type_tags.budget: Planned income, spending, or allocation of money.
document_type_tags.contract: An agreement defining obligations between parties, including identifiable drafts.
document_type_tags.policy: Formal organizational rules or insurance coverage terms.
document_type_tags.form: An application, declaration, questionnaire, or structured form, blank or completed.
document_type_tags.identity-document: Official evidence of identity, residency, or civil status.
document_type_tags.certificate: Formal evidence of completion, qualification, registration, or a recorded fact.
document_type_tags.booking: A reservation, ticket, or booking confirmation.
document_type_tags.warranty: Product guarantees, warranty coverage, or extended protection documentation.
document_type_tags.cv: A CV or résumé, including tailored versions.
document_type_tags.proposal: A proposed engagement, solution, service, or commercial offer.
document_type_tags.plan: Intended actions, sequencing, resources, or milestones.
document_type_tags.meeting-notes: Meeting summaries or minutes documenting discussions, decisions, and actions.
document_type_tags.transcript: A written rendering of spoken content, usually verbatim or close to it.
document_type_tags.interview: Material from, or specifically prepared for, an interview.
document_type_tags.webinar: Material associated with a webinar, including slides, notes, and transcripts.
document_type_tags.presentation: Slides or other material structured for presenting to an audience.
document_type_tags.report: Findings, results, assessments, or periodic status summaries.
document_type_tags.research: Question-driven investigation, research papers, or substantive research notes.
document_type_tags.comparison: Evaluation of alternatives, trade-offs, benchmarks, or selection criteria.
document_type_tags.specification: Defined requirements, interfaces, constraints, or expected behavior.
document_type_tags.architecture: System structure, components, relationships, and design decisions.
document_type_tags.guide: Instructions, manuals, tutorials, procedures, or troubleshooting guidance.
document_type_tags.course-material: Lessons, exercises, lab instructions, handouts, and course resources.
document_type_tags.reading-notes: Summaries, highlights, reflections, or synthesis from reading.
document_type_tags.checklist: Items intended to be checked during preparation, execution, or verification.
document_type_tags.template: A reusable starting structure for producing future documents.
document_type_tags.correspondence: Letters, saved emails, notices, and written exchanges.
document_type_tags.article: Written articles, blog posts, essays, newsletters, or editorial posts, whether drafted or saved.

relationship_tags.received: Reliably known to have been delivered directly to me by another party.
relationship_tags.sent: Reliably known to have been transmitted by me to another party.
relationship_tags.self-created: Reliably known to have been authored by me or generated on my behalf.
